title: PacPack Aroma
description: Vanilla enhanced: massive optimizations, fully client-side, shaders, immersive sounds, and infinite render distance (Voxy). 100% compatible with any Vanilla server!
body:
# PacPack Aroma

A standalone client-side modpack meticulously optimized for Minecraft **26.1.2** using Fabric.

**PacPack Aroma** modernizes the look, feel, and performance of your game while keeping the core gameplay completely untouched. It comes fully loaded with a pre-configured shader suite, curated resource packs, and seamless interface configurations right from the first launch.

> **🔒 100% Server & Realm Compatible:** Every mod, shader, and texture pack runs entirely on your machine. Safely connect to any Vanilla multiplayer server or official Minecraft Realm without any risk of being blocked.

![HUD and visuals improvements](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c87055858508da05381794d2fa01c6a52d4ae19e.jpeg)

## ✨ Features

*   **🚀 Next-Gen Performance:** Powered by a heavy-hitting optimization stack including **Sodium**, **Lithium**, **ImmediatelyFast**, **FerriteCore**, and **CCME**. It maximizes your FPS, slashes memory usage, and eliminates world-loading stutters. **Dynamic FPS** automatically reduces resource consumption when the game is tabbed out.
*   **👁️ Advanced Shader Suite & LabPBR:** Built-in support for legendary shaders natively via **Iris**. Features three pre-configured options right out of the box: **Photon**, **BSL**, and **Complementary Unbound**. Each one has been meticulously fine-tuned for optimal stability, beauty, and full compatibility with LabPBR texture materials. *Note: I also included a config file for *Eclipse Shader* in the modpack, if you want to try it go download the shader on the [Eclipse Shader GitHub](https://github.com/Merlin1809/Eclipse-Shader).*
*   **📦 Curated Visuals & The Infinite Horizon:** Includes a hand-picked selection of performance-friendly resource packs like *Fresh Animations*, *3D Crops Revamped*, *Connected Textures*, and *Clear Glass*. Paired with full **Voxy** integration, vanilla rendering limits are shattered by rendering beautiful Level-of-Detail (LOD) blocks miles into the distance. Visual details are completed with **EMF/ETF**, **3D Skin Layers**, and **WaveyCapes**.
*   **🔊 Immersive Audio Overhaul:** Generates a living soundscape using **AmbientSounds** and **Atmosfera** for rich environmental audio layers. **Sound Physics Remastered** adds realistic 3D acoustics, letting sound physically bounce off cave walls and muffle behind solid obstacles.
*   **🛠️ Streamlined Interface & QoL:** Essential UI upgrades are perfectly adjusted out of the box to prevent overlapping menus. Map your world with **Journeymap**, look at blocks with **Jade**, check recipes with **JEI**, and monitor hunger with **AppleSkin**. Navigation and mining are also streamlined with **Zoomify** and **Veinminer Client**.

---

## ⚠️ Important Information

*   **Server Versions & Compatibility:** This pack is fully optimized for native **26.1.2** environments. While you can connect to public servers running older versions using network proxies (like ViaVersion), you may experience minor visual bugs, interface desyncs, or occasional disconnection errors due to server-side packet translations.
*   **JEI Server Syncing:** JEI (Just Enough Items) is fully functional in singleplayer and on native servers that support item syncing, such as a server running the official [PacPack Aroma Server](https://modrinth.com/modpack/pacpack-aroma-server) companion pack. On pure vanilla multi-version public servers, JEI's item sidebar might automatically hide itself to prevent network protocol conflicts.
*   **Future Updates & Ports:** Backports to older stable versions (such as 1.21.x) as well as day-one updates for future major Minecraft releases are planned and should be published over time.

---

## 💡 Quick Tips

*   **Customization:** The modpack is fully modular. If you want to tweak or disable a feature, simply pause the game, open **Mod Menu**, and click the gear icon next to any mod to adjust its settings.
*   **Shaders & Texture Packs:** Switch between Photon, BSL, and Complementary Unbound on the fly in your video settings. They are already tuned to get the most out of the pre-loaded PBR materials.
*   **Controls:** If you run into any overlapping controls, use the search bar inside the Options menu (powered by **Controlling**) to filter and clear keybind conflicts in seconds.

---
If you encounter any issue, feel free to come on Discord and describe your problem.

*Developed by the PacPack Team. Thank you for using our modpack!*
